Yes, according to the sources provided, you can continue to contribute to the CPP (Canadian Pension Plan) while working and receiving your pension.
You can apply for this benefit if you are 60 to 64 years old and your spouse or common-law partner is eligible to receive the Guaranteed Income Supplement.
This means that you can continue to contribute even after reaching the age of 70, as long as you meet the eligibility criteria set by the CPP.
